title: The Secrets to Civilization
description: In the last decade, the search for data about the planet's environmental history has raised questions about how climate change has influenced human civilizations in the past.

title: Queens of Ancient Egypt
description: Cleopatra Selene, daughter of Cleopatra the Great and Mark Antony, saw her dynasty collapse amid her parents' defeat and suicide; taken to Rome as a prisoner, all looked lost for Selene, but she rose from the embers to marry the African king Juba II.

title: Queens of Ancient Egypt
description: Cleopatra II, namesake of the great Cleopatra VII, had a reign of incest, murder, rape and mutilation; she wielded great power and would do anything to keep it, and she saw her dynasty torn apart by hatred but also saved it from destruction.

title: Ancient Murders Unearthed
description: Homicide detective Rod Demery and Professor Turi King examine Europe's well-known ancient murder victim, who was frozen where he was killed over 5,000 years ago; the team learns how pollen in his gut can suggest his likely route before he died.

title: Ancient Murders Unearthed
description: Homicide detective Rod Demery and forensic scientist Turi King examine a skeleton dated to the time of the Picts and unearthed in a remote sea cave in Scotland; the team recreate the attack to deduce the victim's most likely killer.

title: Deep Time History
description: Linking prehistoric forests to the Industrial Revolution and the rise of modern warfare.
